A.lives: Faint: illumination is brush craft, but the name honors the scribe, not the brush.

G.lives: Faint: dishes serve a table, the feast's own spell; tools coming alive is only implied.

H.lives: A lantern visibly doing its one job, lighting the work, and never pretending otherwise.

J.lives: Quills, inks and knives at work by lamplight: a workshop where tools do the job.

note: The Lamplit Scriptorium is best because its quills, inks and knives visibly do the work by lamplight, so the tools and the craft come alive together.
